description: Ranked lexical frames keep different close observations of an earlier public capture separate (engine §4 and §6.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text $p(prefix) ($x(a) ≻ $x(b))
%conditions matches(without-elision($p), rival-prefix) ⟹ matches(without-elision($x), rival-a), ¬matches(without-elision($p), rival-prefix) ⟹ matches(without-elision($x), rival-b)
%rule prefix t | u
%rule t Q [+T]
%rule u Q [+U]
%rule a X [+V]
%rule b X [+W] [+W]
%rule rival-prefix Q [+T]
%rule rival-a X [+V]
%rule rival-b X [+W] [+W]
